```{r}
#| echo: false
# ---- 9. First-look tables -------------------------------------------
wq <- function(x, w, probs) {                       # weighted quantiles
  k <- !is.na(x) & !is.na(w); x <- x[k]; w <- w[k]
  o <- order(x); x <- x[o]; w <- w[o]
  cw <- cumsum(w) / sum(w)
  sapply(probs, function(p) x[which(cw >= p)[1]])
}

# 9a. Mobility in relative position, not income growth. Quintile cut points
# of equivalised disposable income are recomputed from each year's full
# cross-section, so the table shows where a person sits in the 2023
# distribution given where they sat in 2016. Persons present in both years,
# weighted by w2016; each row sums to 100.
cuts <- PANEL[, .(cut = list(wq(eq_rbd, w, c(.2, .4, .6, .8)))), by = year]
PANEL[cuts, q_rbd := findInterval(eq_rbd, unlist(i.cut), left.open = TRUE) + 1L,
      on = "year", by = .EACHI]
mob <- merge(PANEL[year == 2016L, .(IDENPER, q2016 = q_rbd, w2016)],
             PANEL[year == 2023L, .(IDENPER, q2023 = q_rbd)], by = "IDENPER")
mob_tab <- mob[, .(w = sum(w2016)), by = .(q2016, q2023)]
mob_tab[, pct := round(100 * w / sum(w), 1), by = q2016]
mob_wide <- dcast(mob_tab, q2016 ~ q2023, value.var = "pct", fill = 0)
print(mob_wide)
#fwrite(mob_wide, file.path(OUT_DIR, "03_mobility_q2016_q2023.csv"))


```

```{r}
AN_DIR  <- file.path("panel_hogares", "analyse")
dir.create(AN_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
 
#if (!exists("PANEL")) PANEL <- readRDS(file.path(OUT_DIR, "panel_persons_2016_2023.rds"))
 
EXCLURE_HH_VIDES <- TRUE        # ménages dont aucun membre n'a de RB (eq_* = 0 artificiel)
CAP              <- 3e6         # seuil INE sur les revenus individuels (voir A1)
MOB_DEBUTS       <- c(2016, 2017)  # 2017 = test de sensibilité aux NA de 2016
MOB_FIN          <- 2023
BALANCED_ONLY    <- TRUE        # mobilité longue sur les personnes présentes dans les 8 vagues
FENETRES_PAUV    <- list(2016:2019, 2020:2023)
 
# Sources dont la somme donne eq_rb (D5 du script de construction)
SRC <- c("eq_wages", "eq_pens", "eq_ben", "eq_cap", "eq_rent",
         "eq_bus", "eq_gains", "eq_other")
 
# ---- Fonctions ------------------------------------------------------
wm <- function(x, w) sum(x * w) / sum(w)
 
wq <- function(x, w, probs) {                      # quantiles pondérés
  o <- order(x); x <- x[o]; cw <- cumsum(w[o]) / sum(w)
  sapply(probs, function(p) x[which(cw >= p)[1]])
}
 
# Rang pondéré dans [0, 1] (point milieu, ex aequo au même rang).
# x et w sans NA.
wrank <- function(x, w) {
  o  <- order(x)
  dt <- data.table(x = x[o], p = w[o] / sum(w))
  dt[, cp := cumsum(p)]
  dt[, F := (cp[.N] + cp[1L] - p[1L]) / 2, by = x]   # milieu du bloc d'ex aequo
  r <- numeric(length(x)); r[o] <- dt$F; r
}
 
# Coefficient de concentration de y classé selon le rang F (Gini si y = x)
conc <- function(y, F, w) {
  p <- w / sum(w); mu <- sum(p * y)
  2 * sum(p * (y - mu) * (F - 0.5)) / mu
}
gini <- function(x, w) conc(x, wrank(x, w), w)
 
top_share <- function(x, w, p) {
  s <- wq(x, w, p); sum((w * x)[x > s]) / sum(w * x)
}
 
qgroup <- function(x, w, n)                        # n-tiles pondérés (1..n)
  findInterval(x, wq(x, w, seq_len(n - 1) / n), left.open = TRUE) + 1L
 
wcor <- function(a, b, w) {
  p <- w / sum(w); ma <- sum(p * a); mb <- sum(p * b)
  sum(p * (a - ma) * (b - mb)) / sqrt(sum(p * (a - ma)^2) * sum(p * (b - mb)^2))
}
 
save_csv <- function(x, nom) { fwrite(x, file.path(AN_DIR, nom)); invisible(x) }
 
# ---- A. Échantillon d'analyse ---------------------------------------
# A1. Le PANEL ne garde pas le RBD individuel, donc le plafond INE à ±3 M€
# ne peut pas être appliqué membre par membre. Approximation : on exclut
# les ménages dont un membre a |own_rb| > 3 M€ (très peu de ménages).
# A2. Ménages sans aucune information : exclus si EXCLURE_HH_VIDES.
# Les ménages partiellement renseignés (hh_incomplet) sont gardés et
# sous-estimés ; leur part est affichée ci-dessous.
PANEL[, `:=`(
  hh_vide      = all(is.na(own_rb)),
  hh_incomplet = any(is.na(own_rb) & (is.na(age) | age >= 18)) & !all(is.na(own_rb)),
  hh_extreme   = any(abs(own_rb) > CAP, na.rm = TRUE)
), by = .(year, IDENHOG)]
 
diag_ech <- PANEL[!is.na(w), .(
  pct_pers_hh_vide      = round(100 * wm(hh_vide, w), 1),
  pct_pers_hh_incomplet = round(100 * wm(hh_incomplet, w), 1),
  pers_hh_extreme       = sum(hh_extreme)
), by = year][order(year)]
print(diag_ech)
#save_csv(diag_ech, "A_echantillon.csv")
 
D <- PANEL[!is.na(w) & !hh_extreme & (!EXCLURE_HH_VIDES | !hh_vide),
           c("year", "IDENPER", "IDENHOG", "w", "w2016", "balanced", "age", "sex",
             "CCAA", "eq_rb", "eq_rbd", "eq_tax", SRC, "hh_any_rent"), with = FALSE]
num <- c("eq_rb", "eq_rbd", "eq_tax", SRC)
D[, (num) := lapply(.SD, as.numeric), .SDcols = num]
D[, age_band := cut(age, c(-Inf, 17, 34, 49, 64, 74, Inf),
                    labels = c("<18", "18-34", "35-49", "50-64", "65-74", "75+"))]
 
# Contrôle : les sources somment à eq_rb (écarts d'arrondi seulement)
print(D[, .(ecart_moyen_sources = round(wm(eq_rb - rowSums(.SD), w), 2)),
        by = year, .SDcols = SRC][order(year)])

```

### Income distribution

```{r}
# =====================================================================
# 1. DISTRIBUTION TRANSVERSALE
# =====================================================================
stats_one <- function(x, w) {
  q <- wq(x, w, c(.1, .25, .5, .75, .9))
  list(moyenne = round(wm(x, w)),
       p10 = q[1], p25 = q[2], p50 = q[3], p75 = q[4], p90 = q[5],
       p90_p10 = round(q[5] / q[1], 2),
       gini    = round(gini(x, w), 4),
       top10   = round(100 * top_share(x, w, .90), 2),
       top1    = round(100 * top_share(x, w, .99), 2))
}
 
dist <- rbindlist(lapply(c("eq_rb", "eq_rbd"), function(v)
  D[, c(list(var = v), stats_one(.SD[[1]], w)), by = year, .SDcols = v]))
setorder(dist, var, year)
print(dist)
#save_csv(dist, "1a_distribution.csv")
 
# 1b. Effet redistributif de l'impôt (IRPF + cotisations salariales)
redis <- dcast(dist, year ~ var, value.var = "gini")
redis[, effet_redistributif := round(eq_rb - eq_rbd, 4)]
print(redis)
#save_csv(redis, "1b_effet_redistributif.csv")
 
# 1c. Taux moyen d'imposition par décile de revenu brut équivalent
D[, dec_rb := qgroup(eq_rb, w, 10), by = year]
tax_dec <- D[, .(rb_moyen   = round(wm(eq_rb, w)),
                 taux_moyen = round(100 * sum(w * eq_tax) / sum(w * eq_rb), 1)),
             by = .(year, dec_rb)][order(year, dec_rb)]
#save_csv(tax_dec, "1c_taux_impot_decile.csv")
print(dcast(tax_dec, dec_rb ~ year, value.var = "taux_moyen"))
 
# 1d. Pauvreté : 60 % de la médiane de eq_rbd de l'année (seuil national,
# sur le territoire du panel, sans País Vasco ni Navarra)
D[, seuil := 0.6 * wq(eq_rbd, w, .5), by = year]
D[, pauvre := eq_rbd < seuil]
 
pauv_by <- function(by) D[, .(taux = round(100 * wm(pauvre, w), 1)), by = by]
pauv_an  <- D[, .(seuil = seuil[1], taux = round(100 * wm(pauvre, w), 1)), by = year][order(year)]
pauv_age <- dcast(pauv_by(c("year", "age_band")), age_band ~ year, value.var = "taux")
pauv_sex <- dcast(pauv_by(c("year", "sex")),      sex ~ year,      value.var = "taux")
pauv_cca <- dcast(pauv_by(c("year", "CCAA")),     CCAA ~ year,     value.var = "taux")
print(pauv_an); print(pauv_age); print(pauv_sex)
#save_csv(pauv_an,  "1d_pauvrete_annee.csv")
#save_csv(pauv_age, "1d_pauvrete_age.csv")
#save_csv(pauv_sex, "1d_pauvrete_sexe.csv")
#save_csv(pauv_cca, "1d_pauvrete_ccaa.csv")
```

### Sources of income 

#### Distribution of source of income by decile

```{r}
# Parts de chaque source dans eq_rb (en %). Dans le premier décile, eq_rb
# est proche de 0 : les parts y sont instables et peuvent dépasser 100.
comp <- function(by) {
  x <- D[, c(list(rb = sum(w * eq_rb)), lapply(.SD, function(v) sum(w * v))),
         by = by, .SDcols = SRC]
  x[, (SRC) := lapply(.SD, function(v) round(100 * v / rb, 1)), .SDcols = SRC]
  x[, rb := NULL]
  setorderv(x, by)[]
}
D[, dec_rbd := qgroup(eq_rbd, w, 10), by = year]
comp_dec <- comp(c("year", "dec_rbd"))
comp_age <- comp(c("year", "age_band"))
#save_csv(comp_dec, "2a_composition_decile.csv")
#save_csv(comp_age, "2a_composition_age.csv")
print(comp_dec[year %in% c(2016, 2023)])

```

| Variable | Source | Definition |
|---------------------------|------------------|---------------------------|
| `eq_wages` | M91 | Wages, employer pension contributions, severance pay |
| `eq_pens` | M921 + R1212 | Pensions, incl. exempt incapacity pensions |
| `eq_ben` | M922 + M923 − R1212 | Unemployment, family, dependency and other benefits, incl. IMV |
| `eq_cap` | M93 | Interest, dividends and other capital income |
| `eq_rent` | M94 | Rental income from real estate |
| `eq_bus` | M95 | Self-employment and business income |
| `eq_gains` | M96 | Net capital gains |
| `eq_other` | M97 | Other income under special tax regimes |

*All `eq_*` variables: household total ÷ modified OECD scale, in 2023 euros. The eight sources sum to `eq_rb`.*

```{r}
# 2b. Revenus locatifs : part des personnes dans un ménage qui en perçoit,
# et part du total des loyers captée par le top 10 % de eq_rbd
rent <- D[, .(pct_hh_loyer     = round(100 * wm(hh_any_rent, w), 1),
              part_loyers_top10 = round(100 * sum((w * eq_rent)[dec_rbd == 10]) /
                                          sum(w * eq_rent), 1)),
          by = year][order(year)]
print(rent)
```

- \~ 15% of people perceive rental income

- The proportion of people collecting rental income increases every year between 2016 and 2023

- People in the highest decile of disposable income collect half of the total rents

#### Unequal distribution of the income source 

```{r}
# 2c. Décomposition du Gini de eq_rb par source (Lerman-Yitzhaki) :
# G = somme_k s_k * C_k, avec s_k la part de la source et C_k son
# coefficient de concentration selon le rang en eq_rb.
gdec <- D[, {
  F <- wrank(eq_rb, w); G <- conc(eq_rb, F, w); mu <- wm(eq_rb, w)
  r <- rbindlist(lapply(SRC, function(s) {
    y <- .SD[[s]]; sk <- wm(y, w) / mu
    list(source = s, part = sk, concentration = conc(y, F, w))
  }))
  r[, contribution := part * concentration]
  r[, `:=`(gini = G, pct_contribution = 100 * contribution / G)]
  r
}, by = year, .SDcols = SRC]
num_g <- c("part", "concentration", "contribution", "gini", "pct_contribution")
gdec[, (num_g) := lapply(.SD, round, 4), .SDcols = num_g]
#save_csv(gdec, "2c_decomposition_gini.csv")
print(dcast(gdec, source ~ year, value.var = "pct_contribution"))
setorder(gdec, year)
print(gdec)

```

|  |  |  |
|---------------|----------------------|------------------------------------|
| `part` | mean(source) / mean(`eq_rb`) | Weight of the source in total income. Example: 0.60 = 60% of gross income |
| `concentration` | `conc(source, rank in eq_rb)` | Where the source sits in the distribution. Close to 1: concentrated among the rich. Close to 0: spread evenly. Negative: concentrated among the poor |
| `contribution` | `part × concentration` | Gini points contributed by the source. Contributions sum to the Gini |
| `gini` | Gini of `eq_rb` | Total Gini, same on every row of a given year |
| `pct_contribution` | 100 × `contribution` / `gini` | Percentage of total inequality due to the source |
| `residu_arrondi` | `gini` − Σ `contribution` | Should be close to 0. Non-zero when sources do not add up exactly to `eq_rb` (rounding, missing components) |
